series-convergence-telescoping.alt: For the series with terms a sub n = 1 over n(n + 1), n = 1 to 12: blue bars show each term, starting at 1/2, then 1/6, 1/12 and shrinking toward 0; emerald dots show each partial sum S sub n = n/(n + 1): 1/2, 2/3, 3/4 and so on, rising toward the dashed line at height 1. The sequence of partial sums has limit 1, so the series converges and its sum is 1.
